from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs/task-804c73bb.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker = max((v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for r in grid for x in r))
    # The marker is the non-background color; it is the least frequent color.
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == marker]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1):
                if out[r][c] != marker:
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
